GVM Upgrade RAM 2500: Common Questions and What to Ask Your Installer

Before you commit to a Ram 2500 GVM upgrade pack, there are a few key things worth clarifying regarding your vehicle. First, you’ll want to check how the upgrade changes your total payload and towing limits on your specific truck, along with the Class it’ll be in if you get a certain upgrade completed. 

You’ll also want to check whether your current wheels and tyres are up for the job. With greater weight acting on them, along with a change in ground clearance, you may need to upgrade those too. 

Finally, you might have questions regarding the timeframe and paperwork sign off, which we can help you with. If you have questions and want to speak to our team, contact us any time for more information.
